newsitem.title: USA: MDSI Mobile Data files for 1.5 mln common.
newsitem.headline: MDSI Mobile Data files for 1.5 mln common.

text.p: MDSI Mobile Data Solutions Inc filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 1.5 million common shares.
Of the total, MDSI said it will offer up to 1.37 million shares while 130,000 shares will be sold by certain selling shareholders.
The company said net proceeds will be used to repay notes in connection with an acquisition.
The balance will be used for research and development of new products and technologies, expansion of the company's marketing and sales organization and activities and general working capital.
It said it may also use a portion of the proceeds to acquire, or invest in businesses, products or technologies that expand, complement or are related to the company's business.
The offering will be made through UBS Securities and Unterberg Harris.
